columns.description: Number of columns in the grid. Defaults to `3`.

size.description: Fixed thumbnail size (e.g. `150px`), independent of the column count — use it when you want uniform tiles rather than columns dividing the width.

gap.description: Space between items, as a CSS length. Defaults to `1rem`.

lightbox.description: Clicking any item opens it full-size in a lightbox.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
